newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 14.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Parliamentary draft report suggests Belgium may have been used as a hub for disguised imports of cattle feed containing bonemeal from Britain from 1988. Unpublished report also criticises British and EU authorities and a lack of cooperation among French officials dealing with mad cow disease.
-- Paris bourse hits high at 2,361.27 thanks to improved economic outlook for French companies and a favourable international context.

-- European Commission competition policy officials would prefer to see Credit Lyonnais limit the sell-off of non-profitable networks and are not in favour of it holding on to all its profitable networks.
-- Government pursues reform of SNCF state-owned railway designed to separate operations from infrastructure ownership and maintenance.
